limitations: Specific to the characteristic-three original Gashkov–Sidel'nikov torus model. The theorem improves candidate-probe counts, not total bit complexity. The primary 2026 source full text was inaccessible in this run; the abstract alone was not used to assert whole-document noncoverage.

prior_scientific_review_evidence.correctness: The prior review derives the successful-probe count from the source length-two character criterion, a norm-fiber quadratic, a quartic character sum, and Hasse’s bound, with finite checks as supplementary evidence.
prior_scientific_review_evidence.originality: The prior review distinguishes the exact direct-search half-density and elliptic point-count identity from the recent decoder’s worst-case scan and structured-search estimates.
prior_scientific_review_evidence.value: The prior review values the uniform two-probe-scale decoder analysis and exact leader multiplicity.

provenance: Refines the norm-one-torus decoding description for the original ternary Gashkov-Sidel'nikov codes by exactly counting successful first summands through an explicit genus-one curve.
record_title: Elliptic-curve control of direct torus sampling for Gashkov-Sidel'nikov decoding
